examples.name: Sample — a filing checklist
paragraphs: Two bold group labels, each with a large box before it; ten and one indented items under them, each with a smaller box. Four labelled fill-ins sit in the top-right corner.

examples.name: Sample — boxes on section headings of a court form
paragraphs: PAYMENT OF CLAIM:, DENIAL OF CLAIM and COUNTERCLAIM: each carry a box before the label; the denial line then prints two more boxes inside its sentence (hearing {or} jury trial). Each label stays on its box's line, with what it governs nested beneath it; none becomes a heading.

snippets.text:
<!-- … -->


[ ] PAYMENT OF CLAIM:
Proof of payment (including fees and costs) to Plaintiff is attached (or proof that the requested property was returned to Plaintiff)
Total Amount Paid: $ [blank] (or) Describe property and method of return: [blank]

[ ] DENIAL OF CLAIM
I deny the plaintiff's claim and demand a [ ] hearing {or} [ ] jury trial*
*Claim must total more than $750 (including prejudgment interest, fees, and costs) to request a jury trial

[ ] COUNTERCLAIM:
I make the following counterclaim* against the plaintiff for $[blank]
*Counterclaims must arise out of the same transaction or event as the plaintiff's claim.
I, Defendant, claim that on or about (date) [blank], the above-named plaintiff owed me the amount claimed because [blank], and this amount is still due.
If the amount is the value of property that you believe should be given to you, describe the property: [blank]


<!-- … -->

examples.name: Sample — blank lines used as check marks
paragraphs: Every item is led by ___ rather than a box, including the indented * SCHEDULE A … * SCHEDULE J run. A REFERENCE column of citations sits at the right margin under its own printed header, aligned to the items, so each section is a two-column table whose item cells hold the checklist.

examples.name: Sample — a box before a lettered id
paragraphs: Items (h) to (k) each print a box, then the letter id, then a paragraph with blanks inside it. Each line opens with the box, then the escaped id: - [ ] \[h\].
